task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: CAR navigates to FRONT_CRATE, picks it up to remove obstacle, then navigates to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, picks it up, navigates to MEDICAL_TABLE, and places the MEDICINE_BOTTLE there.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of CAR that needs to be removed
FRONT_CRATE is graspable and within interaction distance after navigation
MEDICINE_BOTTLE is graspable and within interaction distance after navigation
MEDICAL_TABLE is within interaction distance for placing after navigation
CAR can hold only one object at a time, so FRONT_CRATE must be placed somewhere before picking MEDICINE_BOTTLE
